seeded.seed: in destinationExists, lstat was pointed at path + ".tmp" instead of path, so the existing-destination refusal checks a path that is normally absent
seeded.consequence: publishResult and publishDiagnostic no longer refuse an existing destination. prepare and verify run against a destination the caller already holds, and rename then replaces an existing empty destination directory and reports published with that path. Limit: on POSIX rename(2) refuses a non-empty destination directory, so a populated destination still fails at rename (ENOTEMPTY) with its content intact, but only after prepare has run. The security effect is therefore bounded to empty pre-existing destinations; the suite owner should weigh this when classing the case.
